reportedIssues: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price. This is a broken numeric value (Not-a-Number) leaking into the UI, signaling a data parsing/formatting failure.
The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
Secondary metadata text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') uses a fairly light gray that sits near the lower bound of acceptable contrast on white.
